description: Gold beaten into extremely thin sheets, applied to the trimmed edges of a book to give a bright protective surface. The fragile leaf is cut to width on a cushion, lifted with a tip, and laid onto an edge that has been prepared with size and glaire.
name: gold leaf

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (D. Appleton, 1901), Internet Archive
